description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests the Git post-merge hook functionality, including cloning repositories, setting up hooks, and verifying hook execution during different types of merges.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, executing the provided commands.

methods.description: Registers commands to run after the current test finishes, for cleanup.
